headings.instruction: Use Outfit for all Headings (H1 to H4). Apply tracking-tight for sizes above 32px. Do NOT use Inter for headings.

body.instruction: Use Figtree for English body text. Ensure line-height is leading-relaxed for readability.

marathi_support.instruction: Use Noto Sans Devanagari or default system Devanagari fonts for Marathi text. Ensure adequate line height (leading-loose) as Devanagari scripts have top and bottom matras that can clash.

colors.instruction: Avoid harsh pure black. Use #1C2127 for primary text. Use the warm terracotta/saffron (#E65F2B) as the primary action color to evoke energy and approachability without being childish.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use p-6 or p-8 inside cards. Use gap-6 or gap-8 between major sections.
layout_and_spacing.touch_targets: Minimum 48px (h-12) for all interactive elements like buttons, dropdowns, and word toggles to accommodate adult mobile users.
layout_and_spacing.grid: Bento Grid logic for the Dashboard. 1 column on mobile, 2-3 columns on tablet/desktop for the 6 learning sections.

cards.classes: bg-white rounded-3xl border border-slate-100 shadow-[0_4px_20px_-4px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)] overflow-hidden

buttons.primary: rounded-full bg-[#E65F2B] text-white font-semibold h-14 px-8 shadow-sm hover:bg-[#C94F20] transition-colors active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: rounded-full bg-white text-slate-700 font-semibold h-14 px-8 border-2 border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50 transition-all active:scale-95

inputs_and_forms.style: Large, clear, highly accessible. Use Shadcn inputs but increase height to h-14 and text size to text-lg.

learning_interactions.reading_words: inline-block border-b-2 border-dashed border-slate-300 cursor-pointer hover:border-[#E65F2B] hover:text-[#E65F2B] transition-colors py-1
learning_interactions.speaking_mic: w-20 h-20 rounded-full bg-[#E65F2B] text-white flex items-center justify-center shadow-lg shadow-[#E65F2B]/30 hover:scale-105 transition-transform

gamification.progress_bars: h-3 rounded-full bg-slate-100 overflow-hidden, inner bar rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[#E65F2B] to-[#F59E0B]
gamification.badges: Use SVG icons with soft, tinted background circles (e.g., bg-green-100 text-green-600) rather than heavy 3D renders. Keep it professional.
gamification.streak_counter: Top nav element. Icon (Fire) + Number. Active state: text-[#E65F2B].

visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient, soft shadows only. Never harsh drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px subtle borders (border-slate-100) on all floating surfaces.
visual_enhancers.motion: Use framer-motion for micro-interactions: layout animations for list reordering, scale pulses for active microphone, subtle slide-up for entrance animations (y: 20, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1).

media.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone style) for a premium, friendly SaaS look.

images.description: Two women conversing in a professional setup, used as the hero or thumbnail for the Interview Prep module.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text over the primary orange button is pure white. Subtitles must be dark enough (slate-500) to pass 4.5:1 ratio on off-white backgrounds.
accessibility_and_testing.touch_targets: All tappable words and buttons MUST be at least 44x44px. Add padding to inline words if necessary.
accessibility_and_testing.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='reading-word-trigger', data-testid='mic-button').
accessibility_and_testing.language_toggle: Must have an aria-label explaining the language switch, and visually persistent in the header.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a gamified educational app for ADULTS. Do not make it look like a children's game. Use the provided sophisticated color palette.
Ensure 'Bilingual everywhere'. Implement the dual-language content clearly, either side-by-side or stacked with English as primary and Marathi (muted color) right below it.
Use Phosphor Icons (yarn add @phosphor-icons/react) for all icons.
For the 'Reading' section, use a Shadcn popover or custom modal to show word meanings when a dashed word is clicked.
For the 'Speaking' section, implement a visual pulsing effect (using CSS keyframes or framer-motion) when the microphone is active.
Do not use generic center alignment for long text. Keep text left-aligned for better reading.
Include 'data-testid' attributes on all clickable elements, streak counters, XP bars, and level indicators.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not converge toward generic, 'on distribution' AI outputs. Avoid plain centered layouts and simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
DO NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive properties.
DO NOT center align the app container in App.css.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped, rounded-full) with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡 for icons. Use the specified Phosphor icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Use framer-motion.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
